data.name: Crescent Sun
data.detailed_description:
Under the light of the Crescent Sun, heroes decide the fate of the battlefield.

Crescent Sun is a hero-driven roguelite RTS where your chosen heroes shape your entire strategy, from buildings and units to upgrades and battlefield tactics. Semi-automated lanes maintain the frontlines, freeing you to explore the map with up to 5 heroes, adapt your build, and control the flow of fight.

Every run is different. Every hero changes the rules.

HEROES DEFINE YOUR STRATEGY

Your heroes are not just units. They determine your entire playstyle:

  • Available buildings - Certain heroes can construct defensive structures, strengthening your control not only on lanes but across the map.

  • Unit types - Basic units may not be enough. Customize what your lanes deploy through the Lane Manager and expand your creep roster with specific heroes.

  • Upgrade paths - Invest in durable structures, empowered units, or devastating hero abilities. Each run forces meaningful choices.

  • Tactical options - Combine hero abilities, reshape the battlefield, and respond dynamically to enemy pressure.

Choosing a hero means choosing how the entire battlefield will function.

SEMI-AUTOMATED LANES

Lanes continuously clash as allied and enemy units advance toward the most forward tower.

Frontlines shift with every wave. Towers define your defensive line and losing ground changes the flow of battle.

Unlike traditional RTS games, lanes operate semi-independently, allowing you to:

  • Explore the map and gather resources.

  • Secure strategic objectives.

  • Reinforce collapsing fronts.

  • Respond to enemy raids and assassination attempts.

  • Protect your Nexus from direct attacks.

You are not locked into constant micromanagement, you decide where the fight truly matters.

ROGUELITE PROGRESSION

Each run introduces new upgrades, synergies, and strategic decisions.

Unlock new heroes, perks, maps, and higher difficulty levels as you progress, expanding your strategic possibilities with every attempt.

A STYLIZED MYTH-INSPIRED BATTLEFIELD

Inspired by ancient myth and stylized fantasy, Crescent Sun blends strategic warfare with hero-focused progression in a dynamic battlefield that evolves with every decision.

  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 3 1200 AF 4 x 3,4 GHz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1060 6GB
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Procesor Intel Core i5-9600K 6x3.7GHz
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1660 6GB
